name: York University
header:
York University
Canada · Mathematics & Statistics MA (pure mathematics route); PhD normally after a master’s; MSc is Applied & Industrial
Mathematics
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Pure mathematics bachelor’s applicants normally choose the MA, not the applied MSc or direct PhD.
• OGS master’s closes December 1, 2026 at 8 p.m. ET, well before January 15 admission; two scholarship
assessments are distinct from admission references.
• MyFile document/reference stage becomes available only after initial application/payment processing.
• English and old funding pages conflict; do not budget from historical gross-package figures as take-home
pay.
• Faculty list is a verified research shortlist, not proof of available supervision or an exhaustive census.
Teaching-stream appointments need specific supervision confirmation.
• No recent original paper verified. Current profile alone does not show availability to supervise incoming
doctoral students.
• No later original paper verified. Teaching-stream status requires explicit confirmation of graduate-supervision
eligibility and willingness; do not present as a confirmed available research-track doctoral supervisor.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
UChicago four-year mathematics bachelor’s can satisfy the MA degree-level route, subject to York equivalency
and B standing in the final two full-time-equivalent years. The pure-mathematics master’s is the one-year MA;
MSc is Applied & Industrial Mathematics. PhD normally needs an acceptable master’s and B+; the required
supplementary form explicitly requires a master’s by admission, while the 2025-26 calendar permits one year
of comparable work. No direct-from-bachelor PhD exception verified. Older calendar MA B− conflicts with
current B. F-1 does not establish Canadian immigration permission; this dossier assesses academic eligibility.
[reg] [program] [form1] [calendar]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Choose MA/pure mathematics for the bachelor’s route; identify research fit. Submit the initial application and
payment early enough for MyFile access (central estimate 3-5 business days); supporting files and referee
information follow there. Both downloadable mathematics forms are mandatory; a missing Degree and
Program Form prevents consideration. The PhD/MSc form requires two prospective supervisors and their areas.
For thesis MSc/PhD, the committee must find a supervisor before admission; prior contact is advised, not
documented as a universal pre-submission agreement requirement. OGS has an earlier separate deadline.
[apply] [central] [form2] [faq]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Identify fit and contact possible supervisors; mathematics FAQ advises this particularly for thesis MSc/PhD.
PhD/MSc form requires two names, while MA can indicate pure-math interests. Verify graduate-supervisory
eligibility and 2027 capacity directly; a current research profile is not evidence of an available place. See
verified faculty shortlist below, with teaching-stream and publication-recency caveats. [faq] [form2] [guide] [roster]

Initial application/payment precedes MyFile access and document/reference completion. MyFile shows
requirements and receipt; PDFs generally capped at 2.5 MB. Wrong uploads use MyDocServe or contact

fgsapply@yorku.ca if uploads fail. No portal account was created or referee invitation triggered. [central] [help]

mechanics are standing. Funding amounts are historical 2025 indexed brochures with dead direct links; current

sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
Current program lists IELTS Academic 6.5, DET 120, PTE 60, CAEL 60 overall and each component, TOEFL old
scale 88 / new scale 4.5, YUELI Level 6 pass or GSPP pass. Central science regulations instead list old TOEFL
79-80 (valid through December 2027) / new 5-6 and GSPP distinction; Cambridge CPE/CAE entries also differ
(program C1/C versus central C/C1). Obtain written clarification if a test is required. Agency delivery required;
applicant score upload is not accepted. [program] [reg] [central]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Standing exemption: at least one completed full-time year at an accredited university in an English-instruction
country or institution. UChicago study should satisfy this by inference, even before degree conferral, provided
the year is completed. Department FAQ corroborates possible exemption. York reserves discretion to require
testing; confirm waiver in MyFile and supply evidence if requested. Waiver-specific form/deadline and separate
TA assessment were not verified. [reg] [faq]

accept/consider/recommend/prohibit policy was not found. Treat non-requirement as prior-cycle evidence and
confirm optional-score treatment with the program. [oldgre] [program] [form1] [form2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
MA: two; PhD: three. The 2025 MSc brochure also lists two. York normally uses its own emailed standardized
assessment, and the central application page says prewritten recommendation letters are not accepted.
Mathematics-specific professional-versus-academic restrictions were not verified; select academic
mathematicians as practical advice, not a quoted rule. [program] [moneymsc] [central]
Scholarship references [2027 confirmed]
OGS requires two separate assessments; admission letters are not stated to substitute. Master’s form asks
ratings and concrete examples for academic achievement, research promise, and personal/interpersonal
qualities, each narrative limited to 400 words; compare with similar students known within five years. It also
records relationship and years known. Doctoral form requests one assessment addressing these dimensions;
its length limit was not recovered. [ogs] [ogsref] [ogsrefd]

What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Admission referee details go in MyFile’s supplementary-information section. Central instructions say York
emails a standardized form; other programs using MyFile explicitly say submitting names/emails triggers the
request, with Health allowing up to 48 hours. Mathematics-specific immediate-versus-delayed timing remains
unconfirmed. OGS page says adding referees permits unique upload links, but its exact save/submit trigger
and receipt display were not accessible. [central] [help] [film] [health] [ogs]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes relative to the initial application/payment stage: MyFile access arrives afterward and referee details are
entered there. This is a two-stage process; do not wait until every supporting document is uploaded to start
references. No verified mathematics rule makes invitations conditional on completion of all supporting uploads.
[central] [help] [film]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Monitor MyFile for received/not-received supporting-document status; central help describes electronic
recommendations as received immediately after submission. Give referees time to write. Missing invitation:
check spam, then ask Admissions to resend; expired links include PDF-template instructions. OGS-specific
receipt confirmation is unverified. [help]
Updating and reusing letters [Conflict]
Referee replacement requires Admissions assistance. Previous-application letters may be reused only if the
mathematics department approves. A sealed physical letter signed across the flap may be accepted by
program permission, despite the central normal rule against prewritten letters. Writer revision after submission
and OGS reuse/update rules are not publicly confirmed. [help] [central]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required resume/CV. Upload to MyFile; PDF, generic 2.5 MB maximum. Mathematics publishes no specific
prompt, page limit, font or spacing. [program] [help]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required Statement of Interest. Central guide suggests 500-1,000 words, not a verified mathematics hard cap.
Faithful paraphrase of its questions: intended study; reasons for field and York choice; relevant preparation and
experiences; goals after the degree; distinguishing strengths. Upload PDF through MyFile (generic 2.5 MB);
font, spacing and mathematics-specific additional prompts unverified. [program] [guide] [help]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal/background essay listed; the Statement of Interest can address relevant experience. Any
additional MyFile prompt, limit or upload slot remains unverified; do not send unsolicited material. [program]
[help]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required within the forms: MA area of particular interest and PhD intended dissertation area are short spaces
(two lines in the downloadable document). Degree/program form requires PhD/MSc applicants to identify two
prospective supervisors plus research areas. No separate full research-interest essay identified beyond the
Statement of Interest. Preserve the supplied form; exact portal file conversion rules follow MyFile PDF
guidance. [form1] [form2] [help]
Research proposal [Unresolved]
No stand-alone admission research proposal listed for mathematics. OGS separately requires a research
proposal or study plan; see scholarship entry. Admission-specific proposal prompt, length, formatting and
upload permission remain unverified. [program] [form1] [form2] [ogs]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
No admission writing sample, thesis or research-summary requirement listed on mathematics checklist/forms.

Unsolicited documents are discouraged centrally; do not assume paper uploads or links are accepted.
MyFile-specific requests remain possible. [program] [form1] [form2] [help]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate admission publication list listed; CV is required. OGS includes research contributions. Whether
complete papers are wanted, linked, or uploadable is not verified; do not infer permission from omission.
[program] [ogs]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate course-list writing task found in mathematics checklist or downloaded forms; format, prompt and
any portal-only requirement unverified. [program] [form1] [form2]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
OGS 2027-28: prepare proposal/study plan, bibliography, professional experience, academic history,
credentials/recognition, research contributions, relevant activities, transcripts, and two assessments. The page
directs Tri-Council pagination; exact master’s section limits, font/spacing and paper-upload-versus-link details
remain unresolved because the linked OGS-only form timed out/returned 503. Transcript bundle: newest first,
one legend per institution, one PDF; unofficial transcripts allowed, grade reports disallowed. Fall 2026 record is
requested. English or French accepted. Do not substitute admission essays or assume a doctoral format is the
master’s format. [ogs] [ogsform] [ogsguide]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Two required downloadable forms record identity, citizenship/study-visa category, full/part-time status,
intended degree/stream, research area and optional additional information. One asks whether pursuing the
concurrent Financial Engineering diploma (separate internal process after regular admission). Degree/program
form must accompany the application. General MyFile help may request explanations of marginal grades or
study gaps; mathematics applicability and length unverified. No other public short-answer prompts found.

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
No verified 2027 offer amount. Official 2025 brochure search extracts report yearly packages: MA CAD 24,547
domestic / 37,596 international; PhD CAD 31,199 / 46,730; Applied MSc CAD 26,670 / 37,596. Direct MA/PhD
PDFs now returned 404, so figures are retained as historical indexed evidence only. Undated department FAQ
instead gives master’s roughly CAD 14-17k and PhD 27k; basis/year differs or is stale. These are total
packages, not verified net living stipends or separate tuition waivers; individual terms, tax, summer and tuition
deductions require the offer. [moneyma] [moneyphd] [moneymsc] [faq] [account]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MA normal degree length is three terms; Applied MSc six; PhD twelve. 2025 PhD brochure says funding
available for up to five years; this is not a verified five-year guarantee to every admit. Current
package-components table gives normal completion times (MA three terms, PhD four years), not a definitive
offer duration. Ask for funded terms and summer coverage in writing. [program] [moneyphd] [aboutfund]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Central funding table explicitly marks MA/MSc and PhD funding available to international students. Department
warns funded international places have been few and competitive; eligibility is not a guarantee. Full-time York
employees cannot hold graduate packages. OGS admits international applicants, subject to full-time
enrollment and academic eligibility; specific quota/study-permit timing should be checked. [fund] [faq] [ogs]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Maintain continuous full-time enrollment in Fall/Winter/Summer, satisfactory progress and assigned
employment duties. Funding can combine fellowships, awards, TA and RA. Tuition may be paid from
fellowship/award credits; students owe uncovered fees. Fellowship is not indexed for referenda/registration

fees (standing example about CAD 15 per term). York Fellowship holders receive a stated CAD 1,000 health
bursary; the page’s CAD 410 YUGSA cost is undated, not verified for 2027; UHIP cost unverified. Awards go to
student accounts by term, employment/RA monthly to bank; master’s fellowship Fall/Winter installments differ
from summer. Workload and net stipend require offer. [account]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
2025-26 graduate handbook describes automatic funding consideration for non-professional applicants; verify
2027 mathematics package in offer. OGS requires a separate OGS-only application when not using York’s
eligible Tri-Council process. October 2026 guide says late/incomplete OGS applications are not considered. The
guide distinguishes current York students’ FAAS access from prospective applicants’ forms; do not infer the
doctoral cover-sheet procedure applies to an external UChicago applicant. [handbook] [ogsguide]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
OGS provides CAD 5,000 per term for two or three consecutive terms (CAD 10,000-15,000); academic
minimum normally A− in each of the last two completed years for entering graduate students. External award
combinations and lifetime limits apply. Search York’s graduate awards/bursaries directory for additional
opportunities; eligibility, amounts and separate prompts are award-specific. Canadian Tri-Council citizenship
and current-enrollment rules must be checked separately; F-1 alone gives no eligibility. [ogs] [awards]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 140 nonrefundable at initial application, payable by Visa, Visa Debit or Mastercard. Separate
applications/payment for multiple programs. [central]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No mathematics-applicable need-based international waiver verified after central/program/waiver searches.
Ask gradmath@yorku.ca before payment about sponsorship. The public 2026 IEP reimbursement form
expressly excludes other programs and uninvited applicants; it is not a mathematics waiver route. [central] [iep]

fields.label: Amount and coverage
fields.text: No verified 2027 offer amount. Official 2025 brochure search extracts report yearly packages: MA CAD 24,547 domestic / 37,596 international; PhD CAD 31,199 / 46,730; Applied MSc CAD 26,670 / 37,596. Direct MA/PhD PDFs now returned 404, so figures are retained as historical indexed evidence only. Undated department FAQ instead gives master’s roughly CAD 14-17k and PhD 27k; basis/year differs or is stale. These are total packages, not verified net living stipends or separate tuition waivers; individual terms, tax, summer and tuition deductions require the offer. [moneyma] [moneyphd] [moneymsc] [faq] [account]

fields.label: Years of support
fields.text: MA normal degree length is three terms; Applied MSc six; PhD twelve. 2025 PhD brochure says funding available for up to five years; this is not a verified five-year guarantee to every admit. Current package-components table gives normal completion times (MA three terms, PhD four years), not a definitive offer duration. Ask for funded terms and summer coverage in writing. [program] [moneyphd] [aboutfund]

fields.label: International eligibility
fields.text: Central funding table explicitly marks MA/MSc and PhD funding available to international students. Department warns funded international places have been few and competitive; eligibility is not a guarantee. Full-time York employees cannot hold graduate packages. OGS admits international applicants, subject to full-time enrollment and academic eligibility; specific quota/study-permit timing should be checked. [fund] [faq] [ogs]

fields.label: Conditions and duties
fields.text: Maintain continuous full-time enrollment in Fall/Winter/Summer, satisfactory progress and assigned employment duties. Funding can combine fellowships, awards, TA and RA. Tuition may be paid from fellowship/award credits; students owe uncovered fees. Fellowship is not indexed for referenda/registration fees (standing example about CAD 15 per term). York Fellowship holders receive a stated CAD 1,000 health bursary; the page’s CAD 410 YUGSA cost is undated, not verified for 2027; UHIP cost unverified. Awards go to student accounts by term, employment/RA monthly to bank; master’s fellowship Fall/Winter installments differ from summer. Workload and net stipend require offer. [account]

fields.label: Extra funding application
fields.text: 2025-26 graduate handbook describes automatic funding consideration for non-professional applicants; verify 2027 mathematics package in offer. OGS requires a separate OGS-only application when not using York’s eligible Tri-Council process. October 2026 guide says late/incomplete OGS applications are not considered. The guide distinguishes current York students’ FAAS access from prospective applicants’ forms; do not infer the doctoral cover-sheet procedure applies to an external UChicago applicant. [handbook] [ogsguide]

fields.label: Other funding routes
fields.text: OGS provides CAD 5,000 per term for two or three consecutive terms (CAD 10,000-15,000); academic minimum normally A− in each of the last two completed years for entering graduate students. External award combinations and lifetime limits apply. Search York’s graduate awards/bursaries directory for additional opportunities; eligibility, amounts and separate prompts are award-specific. Canadian Tri-Council citizenship and current-enrollment rules must be checked separately; F-1 alone gives no eligibility. [ogs] [awards]

fields.label: Application fee
fields.text: CAD 140 nonrefundable at initial application, payable by Visa, Visa Debit or Mastercard. Separate applications/payment for multiple programs. [central]

fields.label: Fee waiver
fields.text: No mathematics-applicable need-based international waiver verified after central/program/waiver searches. Ask gradmath@yorku.ca before payment about sponsorship. The public 2026 IEP reimbursement form expressly excludes other programs and uninvited applicants; it is not a mathematics waiver route. [central] [iep]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
UChicago four-year mathematics bachelor’s can satisfy the MA degree-level route, subject to York equivalency
and B standing in the final two full-time-equivalent years. The pure-mathematics master’s is the one-year MA;
MSc is Applied & Industrial Mathematics. PhD normally needs an acceptable master’s and B+; the required
supplementary form explicitly requires a master’s by admission, while the 2025-26 calendar permits one year
of comparable work. No direct-from-bachelor PhD exception verified. Older calendar MA B− conflicts with
current B. F-1 does not establish Canadian immigration permission; this dossier assesses academic eligibility.
[reg] [program] [form1] [calendar]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Choose MA/pure mathematics for the bachelor’s route; identify research fit. Submit the initial application and
payment early enough for MyFile access (central estimate 3-5 business days); supporting files and referee
information follow there. Both downloadable mathematics forms are mandatory; a missing Degree and
Program Form prevents consideration. The PhD/MSc form requires two prospective supervisors and their areas.
For thesis MSc/PhD, the committee must find a supervisor before admission; prior contact is advised, not
documented as a universal pre-submission agreement requirement. OGS has an earlier separate deadline.
[apply] [central] [form2] [faq]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Identify fit and contact possible supervisors; mathematics FAQ advises this particularly for thesis MSc/PhD.
PhD/MSc form requires two names, while MA can indicate pure-math interests. Verify graduate-supervisory
eligibility and 2027 capacity directly; a current research profile is not evidence of an available place. See
verified faculty shortlist below, with teaching-stream and publication-recency caveats. [faq] [form2] [guide] [roster]

fgsapply@yorku.ca if uploads fail. No portal account was created or referee invitation triggered. [central] [help]

2026-January 15, 2027. Time of day/timezone not published. FAQ late-October opening is older conflicting

English and GRE
English requirement [Conflict]
Current program lists IELTS Academic 6.5, DET 120, PTE 60, CAEL 60 overall and each component, TOEFL old
scale 88 / new scale 4.5, YUELI Level 6 pass or GSPP pass. Central science regulations instead list old TOEFL
79-80 (valid through December 2027) / new 5-6 and GSPP distinction; Cambridge CPE/CAE entries also differ
(program C1/C versus central C/C1). Obtain written clarification if a test is required. Agency delivery required;
applicant score upload is not accepted. [program] [reg] [central]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Standing exemption: at least one completed full-time year at an accredited university in an English-instruction
country or institution. UChicago study should satisfy this by inference, even before degree conferral, provided
the year is completed. Department FAQ corroborates possible exemption. York reserves discretion to require
testing; confirm waiver in MyFile and supply evidence if requested. Waiver-specific form/deadline and separate
TA assessment were not verified. [reg] [faq]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Prior cycle]
2023-24 department calendar explicitly says GRE examinations are not required, without separating general
and subject tests. Current 2027 checklist and two forms do not list GRE, but a current explicit
accept/consider/recommend/prohibit policy was not found. Treat non-requirement as prior-cycle evidence and
confirm optional-score treatment with the program. [oldgre] [program] [form1] [form2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload unofficial transcripts from every university-level institution, covering completed, unsuccessful,
withdrawn and in-progress study. Official transcripts from every postsecondary institution are required after
conditional admission; York coursework is exempt. Non-English/French documents need notarized translations
according to MyFile help. Upload PDFs through MyFile; generic maximum 2.5 MB each. OGS has its own
transcript package requirement (see scholarship materials). [central] [help]

downloaded form. MyFile may request additional evidence; separate upload permission, format and length not
established. [program] [form1] [form2]

Not listed as a routine mathematics requirement. If requested in MyFile, central help permits a
course-description URL placed in a document then converted to PDF, or mailed descriptions if electronic ones
are unavailable. No required textbook list verified. [program] [help]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
MA: two; PhD: three. The 2025 MSc brochure also lists two. York normally uses its own emailed standardized
assessment, and the central application page says prewritten recommendation letters are not accepted.
Mathematics-specific professional-versus-academic restrictions were not verified; select academic
mathematicians as practical advice, not a quoted rule. [program] [moneymsc] [central]
Scholarship references [2027 confirmed]
OGS requires two separate assessments; admission letters are not stated to substitute. Master’s form asks
ratings and concrete examples for academic achievement, research promise, and personal/interpersonal
qualities, each narrative limited to 400 words; compare with similar students known within five years. It also
records relationship and years known. Doctoral form requests one assessment addressing these dimensions;
its length limit was not recovered. [ogs] [ogsref] [ogsrefd]

What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Admission referee details go in MyFile’s supplementary-information section. Central instructions say York
emails a standardized form; other programs using MyFile explicitly say submitting names/emails triggers the
request, with Health allowing up to 48 hours. Mathematics-specific immediate-versus-delayed timing remains
unconfirmed. OGS page says adding referees permits unique upload links, but its exact save/submit trigger
and receipt display were not accessible. [central] [help] [film] [health] [ogs]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes relative to the initial application/payment stage: MyFile access arrives afterward and referee details are
entered there. This is a two-stage process; do not wait until every supporting document is uploaded to start
references. No verified mathematics rule makes invitations conditional on completion of all supporting uploads.
[central] [help] [film]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Monitor MyFile for received/not-received supporting-document status; central help describes electronic
recommendations as received immediately after submission. Give referees time to write. Missing invitation:
check spam, then ask Admissions to resend; expired links include PDF-template instructions. OGS-specific
receipt confirmation is unverified. [help]
Updating and reusing letters [Conflict]
Referee replacement requires Admissions assistance. Previous-application letters may be reused only if the
mathematics department approves. A sealed physical letter signed across the flap may be accepted by
program permission, despite the central normal rule against prewritten letters. Writer revision after submission
and OGS reuse/update rules are not publicly confirmed. [help] [central]

prompt, page limit, font or spacing. [program] [help]

Faithful paraphrase of its questions: intended study; reasons for field and York choice; relevant preparation and

font, spacing and mathematics-specific additional prompts unverified. [program] [guide] [help]

Amount and coverage [Conflict]
No verified 2027 offer amount. Official 2025 brochure search extracts report yearly packages: MA CAD 24,547
domestic / 37,596 international; PhD CAD 31,199 / 46,730; Applied MSc CAD 26,670 / 37,596. Direct MA/PhD
PDFs now returned 404, so figures are retained as historical indexed evidence only. Undated department FAQ
instead gives master’s roughly CAD 14-17k and PhD 27k; basis/year differs or is stale. These are total
packages, not verified net living stipends or separate tuition waivers; individual terms, tax, summer and tuition
deductions require the offer. [moneyma] [moneyphd] [moneymsc] [faq] [account]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MA normal degree length is three terms; Applied MSc six; PhD twelve. 2025 PhD brochure says funding
available for up to five years; this is not a verified five-year guarantee to every admit. Current
package-components table gives normal completion times (MA three terms, PhD four years), not a definitive
offer duration. Ask for funded terms and summer coverage in writing. [program] [moneyphd] [aboutfund]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Central funding table explicitly marks MA/MSc and PhD funding available to international students. Department
warns funded international places have been few and competitive; eligibility is not a guarantee. Full-time York
employees cannot hold graduate packages. OGS admits international applicants, subject to full-time
enrollment and academic eligibility; specific quota/study-permit timing should be checked. [fund] [faq] [ogs]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Maintain continuous full-time enrollment in Fall/Winter/Summer, satisfactory progress and assigned
employment duties. Funding can combine fellowships, awards, TA and RA. Tuition may be paid from
fellowship/award credits; students owe uncovered fees. Fellowship is not indexed for referenda/registration

fees (standing example about CAD 15 per term). York Fellowship holders receive a stated CAD 1,000 health
bursary; the page’s CAD 410 YUGSA cost is undated, not verified for 2027; UHIP cost unverified. Awards go to
student accounts by term, employment/RA monthly to bank; master’s fellowship Fall/Winter installments differ
from summer. Workload and net stipend require offer. [account]

2025-26 graduate handbook describes automatic funding consideration for non-professional applicants; verify
2027 mathematics package in offer. OGS requires a separate OGS-only application when not using York’s
eligible Tri-Council process. October 2026 guide says late/incomplete OGS applications are not considered. The
guide distinguishes current York students’ FAAS access from prospective applicants’ forms; do not infer the
doctoral cover-sheet procedure applies to an external UChicago applicant. [handbook] [ogsguide]

OGS provides CAD 5,000 per term for two or three consecutive terms (CAD 10,000-15,000); academic
minimum normally A− in each of the last two completed years for entering graduate students. External award
combinations and lifetime limits apply. Search York’s graduate awards/bursaries directory for additional
opportunities; eligibility, amounts and separate prompts are award-specific. Canadian Tri-Council citizenship
and current-enrollment rules must be checked separately; F-1 alone gives no eligibility. [ogs] [awards]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 140 nonrefundable at initial application, payable by Visa, Visa Debit or Mastercard. Separate
applications/payment for multiple programs. [central]

Ask gradmath@yorku.ca before payment about sponsorship. The public 2026 IEP reimbursement form
